title: Carry retirement warnings into the API contract
goal: Use Obsolete declarations to mark retiring operations, response types and properties in generated OpenAPI, then remove only transformers that duplicate those flags.

selectionNotes: Operations, schema types and schema properties are covered. Obsolete messages are source warnings; the generated boolean does not communicate a retirement date or remove an endpoint. This example retains runtime access and suppresses CS0618 only at intentional uses of retiring declarations. Do not remove unrelated transformer behavior, documentation or an enforcement policy.
